quote.text: We don't collect countries — we collect evenings when everyone was sitting together and it was worth the drive to get there.

trips.title: Böhmische Schweiz
trips.coverAlt: PHOTO · Pravčická brána, the stone arch
trips.heroAlt: PHOTO · Sandstone towers above the gorge
trips.excerpt: Two days of sandstone towers and gorges, close enough to leave after breakfast.
trips.intro: Close enough that we left after breakfast and were walking by mid-morning. Sandstone towers, a gorge you cross by boat, and the arch that everyone photographs and nobody manages to make look as big as it is.

media.alt: PHOTO · The arch from the path below
PHOTO · The gorge, from the boat

trips.title: Croatia
trips.coverAlt: PHOTO · Trogir old town from the water
trips.heroAlt: PHOTO · The stone town at the end of the day
trips.excerpt: A stone island town you can cross in ten minutes, and a boat out to the islands nearly every morning.
trips.intro: Trogir is small enough to walk across in ten minutes and old enough that every one of those minutes passes something worth stopping for. We stayed inside the walls, left by boat most mornings, and came back each evening sunburnt and quiet.

media.alt: PHOTO · The old town from above, early morning
media.caption: Before the day boats arrived, the whole place was ours.

quote.text: Let's get up this early every day

media.caption: Out past the breakwater, every morning.

media.alt: VIDEO · The islands from the drone
media.caption: Water that colour doesn't photograph from the ground.
We stopped counting which bay was which.

media.alt: PHOTO · Last evening on the walls
media.caption: The evening we decided to come back in September.

quote.text: Next time, after the boats are gone

trips.title: Dolomites
trips.coverAlt: PHOTO · Ridgeline in the morning light
trips.excerpt: Peaks still holding snow, valleys already green — both seasons in the same afternoon.
trips.intro: May is the strange month here. The valleys have already turned green and the peaks have not yet let go of winter, so you spend the day walking through both at once. We picked routes by how they looked from the car and regretted almost none of them.

media.alt: PHOTO · The ridgeline we still talk about
media.caption: Two hours up, and worth every one of them.

media.alt: PHOTO · Late snow on the north face

trips.title: Barcelona
trips.coverAlt: PHOTO · Rooftops of the Gothic Quarter at dusk
trips.heroAlt: PHOTO · The city at the end of the day
trips.excerpt: November turned out to be the right month — warm enough to sit outside, quiet enough to get a table.
trips.intro: Five days, mostly walking, mostly eating. November turned out to be the right month for it: warm enough to sit outside in the evening, quiet enough that we never once waited for a table.

media.alt: PHOTO · The Gothic Quarter, early morning
PHOTO · Somewhere off Passeig de Gràcia

trips.title: Romania
trips.coverAlt: PHOTO · Bran Castle at dusk, mist over the treeline
trips.heroAlt: PHOTO · The mountains along the Transfăgărășan
trips.excerpt: Bran Castle, the Transfăgărășan, and three days at a cabin with no signal.
trips.intro: The Transfăgărășan is the kind of road you plan a whole trip around, and it earned it. After that, three days at a cabin with no signal — which turned out to be the part everyone talks about now.

media.alt: PHOTO · The road climbing into the mountains
PHOTO · The cabin, no signal, no complaints
